function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Build the full query: for each year, get the driver and constructor with the most points at the final standings
WITH last_race AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
driver_final AS (
  SELECT ds.race_id, ds.driver_id, ds.points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.race_id ORDER BY ds.points DESC, ds.driver_id ASC) as rn
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN last_race lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
  WHERE ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
constructor_final AS (
  SELECT cs.race_id, cs.constructor_id, cs.points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.race_id ORDER BY cs.points DESC, cs.constructor_id ASC) as rn
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN last_race lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
  WHERE cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
)
SELECT lr.year,
       df.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, df.points as driver_points,
       cf.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cf.points as constructor_points
FROM last_race lr
LEFT JOIN driver_final df ON df.race_id = lr.last_race_id AND df.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN driver_final df2 ON df2.race_id = lr.last_race_id AND df2.rn = 2
LEFT JOIN constructors c ON cf.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
LEFT JOIN driver_final df3 ON df3.race_id = lr.last_race_id AND df3.rn = 1
